title: Apparent molar heat capacities of aqueous solutions of CH4, CO2, H2S, and NH3 at temperatures from 304 K to 704 K at a pressure of 28 MPa
experimental_method: Differential flow heat-capacity calorimeter (Carter and Wood design) measuring cp,s/cp,w of dilute gas solutions relative to water at about 28 MPa, 304 to 704 K; Cp,phi from eq (1) with water cp from Hill's equation of state.
uncertainties_stated: Molality (0.7, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3) per cent for CH4, CO2, H2S, NH3; T 0.05 K below 600 K, 0.2 K above, up to 0.7 K at 658-678 K; Cp,phi about 1 per cent below 623 K, up to about 25 per cent of the peak value near and between the extrema.
quality_remarks: Values are averages of two or more experiments. Very large positive and negative Cp,phi near the critical region of water (661 to 675 K). Temperature scale not stated. Note: in the text layer the plus-minus sign is encoded as '2' and the copyright sign as '7' (text only; tables unaffected).
